description: Mark a fact as no longer true, with no replacement value. Appends a tombstone: the fact stops being returned as current but stays in the history. Use when something stopped being the case and nothing took its place. Returns 404 (and refunds the credit) if the key has no live fact. Costs 1 credit.

context.description: Optional. A project or session tag for provenance.

written_by.description: Optional. Who or what retired this fact (provenance).

name: retire_assertion
